graph filter banks are a natural generalization of classical filter banks and that the eigenstructure of A plays a crucial role in the design of graph filter banks, but that the eigenstructure is not a restriction, but rather a design tool.

for M-block-cyclic graphs with distinct eigenvalues, there is no difference between the theory of graph filter banks and classical multirate filter banks, but that for general graphs, there are many important differences, some of which can be addressed by using the polyphase representation.
